sources.title: [2309.04662] MADLAD-400: A Multilingual And Document-Level Large ...
sources.snippet: We introduce MADLAD-400, a manually audited, general domain 3T token monolingual dataset based on CommonCrawl, spanning 419 languages. We discuss the limitations revealed by self-auditing MADLAD-400, and the role data auditing had in the dataset creation process. We then train and release a 10.7B-parameter multilingual machine translation model on 250 billion tokens covering over 450 languages ...

sources.title: madlad400-3b-ct2 Open-source Multilingual Translation Model - Supports ...
sources.snippet: MADLAD-400-3B-CT2 is a multilingual machine translation model based on the T5 architecture, trained on public data of 1 trillion tokens covering over 450 languages. This model supports over 400 languages, focuses on machine translation and multilingual NLP tasks, and is also competitive compared to larger-scale models.
